newsitem.title: JAPAN: Prosecutors confirm arrest of former Nomura execs.
newsitem.headline: Prosecutors confirm arrest of former Nomura execs.

text.p: Japanese prosecutors on Wednesday confirmed that they had arrested three former executives of Nomura Securities Co Ltd.

"We have arrested the three people on suspected violations of the securities exchange law and the commercial code. We are continuing the investigation of their homes and offices," said Deputy District Chief Prosecutor Kunihiro Matsuo.
Earlier on Wednesday afternoon, Matsuo denied Japanese media reports that the three had been arrested.
On Tuesday, the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC) filed complaints with prosecutors asking for criminal charges against the three former executives as well as the firm itself.
Government sources said the complaints by the watchdog allege that Nomura and the employees made illegal payments to a corporate client totalling 49.7 million yen ($417,600).
